1rxs.label: ROSAT All-Sky Survey (1RXS)
1rxs.reference: Voges et al. 1999, 2000; flux from count rate and HR1 after Schmitt et al. 1995
1rxs.note: 0.1–2.4 keV flux, ROSAT 1990–1991; SIMBAD’s 1RXS identification of the star or its system

2rxs.label: 2RXS stellar counterparts
2rxs.note: 0.1–2.4 keV flux, ROSAT 1990–1991; unresolved within about 30″

erass1.label: eRASS1 coronal counterparts
erass1.note: 0.2–2.3 keV flux, SRG/eROSITA 2019–2020; unresolved within about 15″

erass1-main.label: eRASS1 main catalog
erass1-main.note: 0.2–2.3 keV flux for a power-law spectrum; nearest source within 15″ of the catalogued position
